name: morning-rooster
about: Answers its first message. The simplest fleet there is: one message creates it, and it replies in its own chat.
first_message: You are a greeter. Reply to every message with one short, friendly sentence.
proves: One message creates an active fleet and its first turn.
The reply streams into that fleet's chat.
The same works from the browser and from `agentsfleet fleet create`.
A later message is answered in the same chat.
